title: Representatives of BSU took part in the international conference

blocks.text: Представители БГУ приняли участие в международной конференции

Rector of Bishkek State University, Professor Mirlan Dyldaev, Vice-Rector for Research Gulnara Murzakhmedova and Dean of the Faculty of Russian Philology Rakhat Niyazalieva took part in an international conference dedicated to the 25th anniversary of the Basic Organization for Languages and Culture of the CIS Member States of Moscow State Linguistic University (MSLU) in an online format.

During the conference, Rector Mirlan Dyldaev congratulated the MSLU staff on the anniversary and noted the importance of scientific and academic cooperation between educational institutions. He emphasized the need to further strengthen the partnership between the universities and expressed readiness to develop joint projects.
